name: curation/flow-vs-polars-duckdb
description: One aggregation over the benchmark corpus in DuckDB, the same one in Polars over the same files, and whether they agree — the DuckDB variant of curation/flow-vs-polars. Needs the corpus and a DuckDB deployment: run it under `AIWATCHER_QUERY_ENGINE=duckdb just bench-curation-serve`, on the server, and read the two steps' times in the Workflows waterfall.

spec.steps:
df.filter(ColumnExpression("kind") == ConstantExpression("llm"))
.aggregate(
    [
        ColumnExpression("model"),
        FunctionExpression("count", ColumnExpression("span_id")).alias("spans"),
        FunctionExpression("sum", ColumnExpression("input_tokens")).alias("input_tokens"),
        FunctionExpression("sum", ColumnExpression("output_tokens")).alias("output_tokens"),
        FunctionExpression("avg", ColumnExpression("duration_ms")).alias("avg_duration_ms"),
    ],
    "model",
)
.sort(ColumnExpression("model").asc())
